name: Tsuchiya Shizuku
source:
A girl who was already an indoors type and became a shut-in as a result of a certain incident during middle school.

Despite her gloomy appearance, she is a romantic who loves shoujo manga and holds on to a sappy hope of living a sweet school life with her lover, despite herself acknowledging it as an unattainable dream.

Her parents are divorced, and she lives alone with her mother in a one-room flat.
